parameters: A bit dramatic with that whole 'end of the world' speech, don't ya think?
...\n[8] is not familiar with the Temple's ways.\! It may be just what \n[5] needed to hear.
...You're really serious about this stuff, aren't you?
Just as the cult was deliberate in finding the Nephilim, so too must the Paladins be when countering their actions.
Must be easy to think everything and anything happens for a reason...\! As though the fate of all reality is set in stone, so why bother setting out to change it?
...There are some things I would change, Stefan.\! The life of a warrior is difficult.\! The comforts of home call out to me...
Little Alex?\! Yeah, bet the kid really misses you...
Yes...\| But my son deserves a better world to inherit.\! If Zanatus is returning to our world, I must remain out here, fighting against fate, inevitable as though it may be.
Yeah... I hear ya.\! He's a good kid.\! Wish I had somethin' as precious as Alex is to you.
...My Alex worships you.\! You're practically his own father.
Can you play that tune he likes so much? I have grown very fond of it as well...
Just gonna make you miss home even more...
